categories.main_business_segments: Empyrean Technology Co., Ltd. primarily develops, sells, and services Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software tools for integrated circuit (IC) design, manufacturing, and packaging. Their product portfolio covers full-custom design platforms for analog, storage, RF, and flat panel display circuits, digital circuit design tools, wafer manufacturing EDA tools, advanced packaging design tools, and 3DIC design tools. They also provide related technical services including IP cores and wafer manufacturing engineering services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced EDA technologies including full-process design automation, circuit simulation, physical verification, parasitic extraction, and reliability analysis. They integrate AI, GPU acceleration, and cloud computing to enhance design efficiency and accuracy. Their tools support cutting-edge semiconductor processes down to 4nm, multi-technology co-simulation for 3DIC, and advanced packaging with automated routing and verification. They also develop proprietary platforms like PyAether for AI-driven design automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Empyrean serves integrated circuit design enterprises, wafer foundries, packaging companies, and flat panel display manufacturers. Their customers include analog, storage, RF, digital, and system-level chip designers, with applications spanning computing, communications, data centers, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and industrial control. The company has nearly 700 domestic and international customers, including leading chip design and manufacturing firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Beijing, China, with subsidiaries and offices in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Chengdu, Xi'an, Guangzhou, and Tianjin. It also operates overseas subsidiaries in the United States, South Korea, and Hong Kong, serving global markets. The majority of revenue is generated domestically, with a smaller portion from international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Empyrean operates primarily in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing essential EDA software tools and technical services that enable IC design, wafer manufacturing, and packaging. Their products are foundational to the semiconductor design and production process, supporting chip designers and foundries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding full-process EDA tool coverage across all IC design domains, enhancing support for advanced semiconductor processes, and integrating AI and cloud technologies. Key R&D initiatives include upgrading simulation and verification tools, developing digital design and specific chip-type EDA solutions, and advancing 3DIC design capabilities. They emphasize talent development, industry collaboration, and strengthening their core technology portfolio to achieve international competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Empyrean generates revenue mainly through software licensing fees for its EDA tools, typically based on time-limited contracts. Additionally, it earns income from technical service projects priced according to workload and complexity. Hardware and third-party software sales constitute a minor portion of revenue. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Globally, the EDA market is dominated by three major players: Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, and Siemens EDA. Empyrean is positioned in the second tier globally and is the leading domestic EDA provider in China. It competes by offering comprehensive full-process tools and localized solutions, aiming to reduce reliance on foreign EDA software and expand its market share domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Empyrean reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a 21% increase over the previous year, marking a record high. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 109 million, down 45% year-over-year. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of over 70% of revenue, with 914 R&D staff. Total assets stood at RMB 5.63 billion, with steady growth in net assets. Cash flow from operations was negative due to increased talent investment and contract timing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Empyrean emphasizes its comprehensive full-process EDA tool coverage across analog, storage, RF, digital, flat panel display, wafer manufacturing, advanced packaging, and 3DIC design, which few domestic competitors offer. Their tools incorporate AI, GPU acceleration, and cloud integration to significantly improve design efficiency and accuracy. The company holds numerous patents and software copyrights, supports advanced semiconductor nodes, and complies with international safety standards, positioning itself as a critical enabler of China's semiconductor self-reliance and innovation.
